IS 9401 : Part 7 : 2013 : Method of Measurement of Works in River Valley Projects (Dams and Appurtenant Structures): Part 7 JointsICS 93.160WRD 23Reaffirmed 20221. ScopeThis standard (Part 7) covers the method of measurement of joints and connected auxiliary works in river valley projects, such as, dams, hydraulic structures, canals and power houses2. ReferencesThe standards listed below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards listed below:9401(Part 2) : 2003 Method of measurement of works in river valley projects (dams and appurtenant structures): Part 2 Dewatering (first revision)9401(Part 3) : 2003 Method of measurement of works in river valley projects (dams and appurtenant structures): Part 3 Grouting (second revision)
